description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for three SepLLM configurations, with an additional horizontal dashed reference line. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 93,000 to 128,000, with regularly spaced tick labels every 5,000 iterations (e.g., 95,000, 100,000, …, 125,000). The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at 0.2 intervals (2.0, 2.2, …, 3.0). The magenta solid line (SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)) starts near the top of the axis around 3.0 at the left edge, drops steeply by about 95k–100k iterations to roughly the mid–2.4 range, then continues a gradual decline, ending near about 2.22 at ~128k. The blue solid line (SepLLM (n=128)) begins near ~3.0 at the left edge, decreases to around ~2.6 by ~100k, then declines more slowly, ending near about 2.28–2.29 at ~128k. The orange solid line (SepLLM (n=64)) similarly starts near ~3.0, falls to around ~2.6 by ~100k, shows a narrow upward spike slightly after 100k (peaking just below ~2.85), and then resumes a gradual downward trend, ending near about 2.30 at ~128k. A red dashed horizontal line is drawn at approximately Loss = 2.35 across part of the plot (visible from roughly the mid-94k region to around 100k).
